_meta.description: Source-grounded, permission-aware intent-response knowledge base for Kairos. Covers both customer-facing commercial topics (positioning, pricing, trial, demo, multi-tenancy, workspace policies) and in-app employee surfaces (clock-in, screenshots, leave, payslips, privacy, support). URLs appear in responses only for the Temveris contact page, signup, and other approved domains pinned in commercial intents. search_redirects map keywords to in-app navigation routes for the frontend router. Keywords are maximized to cover all common user phrasings, typos, casual language and synonyms.

tone: Clear, professional, helpful, sales-aware, and implementation-safe.
Use concise answers first, then offer a practical next step.
Do not over-explain internal architecture unless the user is an admin, buyer, or technical evaluator asking about it.
global_response_rules.sales_doctrine: Sales must be at the heart of every customer-facing answer, page, flow, and CTA. Kairos should guide qualified users toward the right commercial next step without being pushy.

default_ctas.existing_customer: Talk to your customer success contact

never_do: Do not invent features, integrations, certifications, customers, case studies, or compliance reports that are not in the approved knowledge base.
Do not state that multi-tenancy is fully live unless the deployment flag says it is live.
Do not expose internal terms such as tenant, schema isolation, row-level security, or correlation_id to ordinary end users unless needed and safe.
Do not provide legal, payroll, tax, HR, or employment advice. Recommend a qualified adviser where appropriate.
Do not tell customers that Temveris recalculates, edits, or overrides official payroll or payslip values.
Do not position Temveris as employee surveillance. Use workforce assurance, accountability, transparency, and governed evidence language.

intents.response:
Temveris is a workforce assurance and performance intelligence platform — not a surveillance tool.

It helps organisations:

✅ Verify work — verified records and session confidence scores
✅ Govern accountability — policy-aware, role-aware, jurisdiction-aware rules
✅ Support distributed teams — for hybrid, remote, contractor-heavy, and client-billable work
✅ Stay audit-ready — exportable logs, evidence packs, and access trails
✅ Keep workers in the loop — transparent worker-facing controls and dispute routes

Temveris is best fit for distributed, hybrid, contractor-heavy, BPO, client-billable services, and regulated or audit-sensitive teams.

As an employee, Temveris gives you full visibility into what is recorded about you and why — with correction and dispute routes always available.

keywords: difference between active time and work hours

intents.response:
📊 Active Time vs Total Work Hours

Total Work Hours — Total time from clock-in to clock-out including breaks
Active Time — Time you were actively using your device: keyboard, mouse, apps
Break Time — Time you were officially on a recorded break
Idle Time % — Percentage of work time where no activity was detected
Productive Apps % — Percentage of time spent in work-classified applications

Example: If you worked 1h 17m and Active Time is also 1h 17m, your Idle Time is 0% — meaning you were active throughout your entire session.

intents.response:
💤 Idle Time — What It Means

Idle Time is recorded when no keyboard, mouse or application activity is detected for a set period.

Common reasons you may see Idle Time:
- You stepped away from your desk without taking a formal break
- You were on a phone or video call without touching the screen
- Your screen locked or the device went to sleep
- You were reading a document without scrolling or clicking

What to do:
If the idle time was legitimate work such as a meeting or a call, you can submit a Time Correction via My Timesheet.

Important: Idle time is not automatically treated as non-work. It is a signal reviewed in context by your manager according to your organisation's policy.
suggestions: How do I correct my time?

intents.response:
🛡️ Work Authenticity — Proof-of-Work Confidence

Every work session receives a Work Authenticity Score from 0 to 100%.

How it's calculated:
- 📸 Screenshot integrity (if screenshots are enabled)
- ⌨️ Keyboard and mouse activity patterns
- 🖥️ Device verification signals
- 🔍 Tamper detection checks

What the statuses mean:
✅ Validated — Session passed all checks with high confidence
⚠️ Warning — Minor signals detected, reviewed in context
🚨 Flagged — Session failed one or more integrity checks
⏳ Pending — Session is still being processed

A flagged session does not mean punishment. It means the system flagged something for human review. All decisions are made by authorised people — not an automated system.

View all your sessions under My Data → What's Recorded.

keywords: why do i have a flag
intents.response:
🚨 Why Was My Session Flagged?

A flagged session does not automatically mean wrongdoing. Common reasons:

- Very low keyboard or mouse activity during a long session
- Screenshot data was missing or incomplete (if screenshots are enabled)
- Unusual activity pattern compared to your baseline
- Device verification signal was not received

What happens next:
1. A human reviewer — your manager or HR — reviews the session
2. No automated disciplinary action is taken by Kairos
3. You will be informed if action is required by your organisation

You can dispute it:
Go to My Data → What's Recorded → select the session → Raise a Dispute

Kairos cannot change session scores or remove flags — that requires human review.

intents.response:
📝 Raising a Dispute or Correction Request

For session disputes:
1. Go to My Data → What's Recorded
2. Find the session in question
3. Click Raise a Dispute
4. Describe the issue and submit

For time corrections (missed clock-in or clock-out):
1. Go to Time & Attendance → My Timesheet
2. Select the date
3. Click Request Correction, enter your reason and submit

What happens after:
- Your manager or HR is notified
- They review and approve or decline your request
- You receive a notification on the outcome

Kairos cannot approve or modify your records. All correction decisions are made by authorised humans in your organisation.

intents.response:
📸 Screenshots — What You Need to Know

Are screenshots taken?
Screenshots are only taken if your organisation has enabled this feature. Not all workspaces use screenshots.

If screenshots are enabled:
- They are taken at intervals set by your organisation's policy
- Only authorised roles such as manager, HR and admin can review them
- You can view your own screenshots under Work & Activity → Screenshots
- Sensitive content masking rules may apply based on your policy

Privacy controls:
- You can see your own screenshots at any time — there is no hidden capture without your knowledge
- Screenshots during break time may be excluded depending on your org's policy

If you believe a screenshot was taken unfairly, raise a dispute under My Data → What's Recorded.

If screenshots are enabled and you believe sensitive personal information was captured, go to My Data → What's Recorded, select the session and raise a dispute.

intents.response:
🔒 What Temveris Records About You

Temveris is built on a transparency-first principle — you always know what is recorded.

What may be recorded depending on your org's policy:

⏱️ Work Time — Clock-in, clock-out, active time, break time, idle time
📱 App Activity — Apps used and time spent, Productive, Neutral or Restricted
📸 Screenshots — Periodic screenshots only if your org has enabled this
🖥️ Device Signals — Device type, session continuity, verification checks
🔐 Access History — Who accessed your data, when and why

What is NOT recorded:
- Personal apps or websites excluded by policy
- Content you type — keylogging is not used
- Audio or video of you personally
- Any data outside your defined work sessions

Your rights:
- View your own data: My Data → What's Recorded
- See who accessed your data: My Data → Access History
- Manage preferences: My Data → Privacy Settings
- Raise corrections or disputes at any time

intents.response:
🔐 What Temveris Does NOT Record

Temveris does not use keylogging and does not record the content you type. It does not record personal audio or video of you.

Screenshots may only be taken if enabled by your organisation and are shown transparently within the app — you can always view your own screenshots.

Temveris tracks app activity (which apps are open and for how long) — not what you write, say or see in those apps.

🏢 Organizations, Workspaces & Data Separation

Temveris is designed around organizations and workspaces with controlled data separation:

• Organization — the customer company that owns the subscription.
• Workspace — the operational environment where you manage teams, policies, workers, reporting, and settings.
• Subscription — your plan, seats, billing cadence, and lifecycle state.
• Entitlement — a computed permission that decides which features your workspace can use.

Provisional access (before verification) lets users sign in, view onboarding, review trial status, and configure limited settings — but blocks worker invites, data exports, billing admin changes, and sensitive integrations until verification is complete.

For details on your specific deployment model, talk to Temveris support or sales.

intents.question: Can Temveris recalculate my payslip
intents.response:
💼 Payslips — What Temveris Does and Doesn't Do

Where enabled, Temveris can display and secure official payslips issued by your employer or payroll provider. Temveris does not recalculate, reinterpret, edit, or override official payslip values unless Temveris is contractually configured as your payroll processor of record.

If your payslip looks wrong:
• Contact your employer or payroll administrator for corrections.
• Your manager / HR can also review the underlying time records in Temveris alongside your official payslip.

Kairos cannot adjust payroll values, taxes, or deductions — that authority sits with your payroll provider.
